facts.fact: 本章题眼：真相是反高潮，连神也会衰朽
facts.anchor: The truth is an anticlimax. Even gods, in time, decay.

facts.fact: ch33 的胜利总结：他面对电塔并赢了——战胜的是自己的恐惧
facts.anchor: And he had faced the pylon and won: his fear of it was defeated.

facts.fact: 雾夜雪人消失：小径旁没有雪人，雪干净平整，无脚印无拖拽
facts.anchor: But there was no snowman by the path; the snow was clear and even.

facts.fact: 雾中人影的苹果嘴是方圆数英里唯一的颜色
facts.anchor: The apple-mouth was very red. It seemed like the only colour for miles.

facts.fact: 声音在雾里叫他 Arthur 并命令他看
「我知道你做了什么」第四次复现：从电线里贴着耳边嘶嘶道出
facts.anchor: I know what you did, hissed the voice from the wires

facts.fact: 声音挑衅：那就转身，我敢你
facts.anchor: Then turn around. I dare you.

facts.fact: 他猛然转身狂喊「什么都没有」——以为证明了无
facts.anchor: He turned abruptly on his heel with a cry of defiance. There. A surge of triumph went through him. ‘Look! Nothing! Nothing! There’s nothing there!’

facts.fact: 讽刺落点：雪人就在他身后原处，背对房子，围巾红得刺眼
facts.anchor: Except that the snowman was back in its place at the top of the footpath, back turned, facing the moor, headscarf red against the snow.
